shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up the face of the bowyer's house past its burning door torch and over the roofline to reveal Lytelthorpe Keep on its hill; stay 6 m off the facade and 5 m above the roof.
shots.notes: Opener. Starts at eye level in the main street facing the Bowyer/Tailor house (0x0100082E, top z 52.5) whose door torch (0x020005D8, flame + warm glow 0x32000829) burns lower-right of frame (ndc 0.44,-0.92), rises 17.5 m past the facade and over the roofline; the keep is hidden by the house for the first ~6.5 s (LOS blocked 26/49 samples) and is revealed centred with both spire towers against the clouds. Verified: start (36755.1,24622.6,41.3) ground 39.5 (WBT get-height 39.57); facade 6.3-7.8 m away during the rise, end 6.3 m above the roof plane and 8.4 m off the face; nearest scenery 4.3 m (shrub 0x020002F2 top 42.7) and 4.4 m (tree 0x02000246 crown 36-45, behind camera); query-radius 6 m = 0 statics; vmax 2.3 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Orbit the keep at a steady 52 m radius, 36 m above the courtyard; keep the keep and both spire towers in frame and stay outside the tower spires.
shots.notes: Grand aerial: 0.29-rev counter-clockwise orbit from WSW (sun behind the camera, keep front-lit) round to SSE (raking side light), 52 m radius, z 90 = 5.2 m above the keep/tower spire tips (z 84.75) and 31 m above the curtain walls; whole square fortress, its three pyramid-roofed towers, the wooded courtyard and the town below. Verified: AGL 36.5-44 over terrain 45.8-53.3; nearest object 28.6 m (NW tower AABB); no scenery within 32 m; vmax 6.8 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Truck east along the south curtain wall and gatehouse 9 m off the stones and 2.5 m high with the head locked north; never drift toward the wall or the low shrub at the east end.
shots.notes: Building-side pan: classic truck parallel to the south curtain wall and gatehouse (0x01001130, gate door wcid 568, guard Chandler Hammett) on the open plateau apron, head locked north, gate crossing frame centre at mid-move; keep tip and NW spire stay in the upper frame (ndc y 0.91 / 0.43), low western sun rakes the wall. Verified: line y 24673.0 (9.3 m off the gatehouse face 24682.25, 9.3 m off the SW/SE bastions), x 36711->36743, z 56.5 = 2.5 m AGL on flat ground z 54.0 (WBT); nearest obstacle a 0.8 m shrub 0x020007A2 4.35 m away (below lens), bush 0x020002F2 5.8 m at the east end; query-radius 6 m = 0 statics; LOS to wall clear; vmax 4.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hold low at the foot of the north-west spire tower looking steeply up its sunlit face into the clouds; keep 6 m from the stones.
shots.notes: Low-angle detail: lens 1 m off the grass 13 m WSW of the NW spire tower (0x01001161, 30.75 m, pyramid spire tip z 84.75), looking up 48 deg at its sun-lit west face with the spire in the upper third (ndc y 0.44) and clouds behind. Verified: camera (36696.7,24725.5,55.0), ground 54.0; tower wall polygon 5.8-6.1 m away (conservative AABB 4.3 m); default-scenery nearest 6.8 m (a retail-bake-only 1 m shrub sits 2.9 m behind the camera and is not rendered in the film's default scenery bake); query-radius 6 m = 0 statics.

shots.standingOrder: Cross the fortress northward 38 m above the courtyard with the gimbal tracking straight down past the keep's spire roof; climb rather than swerve if any spire comes within 6 m.
shots.notes: Flagship crossing: level northward pass at z 92 (38 m above the courtyard), gimbal tracks the keep down through nadir (yaw-slew <=45 deg/s) and back up behind - curtain walls, courtyard trees, the gate and the two north spire towers wheel through frame. Verified: 7.25 m above the keep spire tip (84.75) at closest, NW/NE spires >= 14 m away horizontally, AGL 38 over flat plateau z 54; path y 24678->24738 at x 36732; vmax 5 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Slow push toward the swirling Town Network portal in the square by the well; stop at least 3 m from the portal and never cross the well.
shots.notes: Particle effect (magic): slow perceptual push from WS (13.7 m) to FS (6.3 m) on the swirling Portal to Town Network in the open square, the well on the left edge, Sitrath's Smithy behind; western sun behind the camera. Verified: line from (36798.0,24643.2,37.6) to (36805.1,24645.1,36.9), 2.9-3.6 m AGL over z 34.0 (WBT); Healer house 0x01000BC3 >= 5.0 m, tree 0x02000240 >= 6.5 m, portal >= 4.9 m (6.3 m to centre), well 11.6 m; LOS clear; vmax 1.7 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Hold still beside the magic shop with its door torch burning sharp in the lower left, then pull focus up the hill to the keep; nothing may cross between the lens and the torch.
shots.notes: Particle effect (fire) + rack focus: locked off beside the Magic of Iiwah shop, its door torch (0x020005D8 flame + glow) sharp in the lower left (ndc -0.63,-0.63, 6.6 m), focus pulls at 45% to Lytelthorpe Keep on the hill 88 m away (right third, ndc 0.31). Verified: camera (36717.9,24623.9,45.9), ground 44.0 (WBT), 1.9 m AGL; house 0x01000827 5.3 m; LOS to keep clears the gatehouse and slope (0/29 samples blocked); query-radius 6 m = 0 statics; dof focusRange 10 keeps the whole keep crisp after the pull.

shots.standingOrder: Start level with the keep's open lookout under its spire roof where the braziers burn, then pull back and up in one straight line to the south-south-west until the fortress, town and farmland open up; stay 7 m clear of the keep.
shots.notes: Closing dronie: starts level with the keep's open top lookout (floor z 69.2, parapet 70, pyramid eave 72) where Lord Aleval stands among four tall fire braziers (0x0200034C, fire plume 0x320001AF + smoke), both brazier flames near frame centre (ndc +-0.3), then pulls back and up 16 s to the SSW until the whole fortress, the town and the farmland spread out. Verified: start (36725.2,24693.5,71.7) is 7.5 m from the keep's eave AABB, 12.7 m above the gatehouse/bastion tops (59); end (36694.0,24626.4,111.2) 69 m AGL; nearest object 7.5 m at t=0 then > 11 m; vmax 8.2 m/s (cinema preset 12).
